{{Quote|I've seen thousands drop dead from Tarisian Toxic Flu. Watched cities vaporize from proto-isotope bombs. Nothing like this. Thought it would be dead silent.|HMC-10|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A '''proto-isotope bomb''' was a powerful type of bomb that could vaporize an entire [[City/Legends|city]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[HMC-10]] had witnessed such an event by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Invasion of Ziost]].
